ModMetaData.name: LC Abnormalities
ModMetaData.author: DarthCY
ModMetaData.description:
Consolidated Lobotomy Corporation abnormality content pack for RimWorld 1.7. Requires LC Anomaly Core and does not require the Anomaly DLC.
Included abnormalities: - One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds (ZAYIN) - Peccatulum / SevenSin Entities (ZAYIN) - We Can Change Anything (ZAYIN Tool) - Old Belief and Promise (ZAYIN Tool) - Meat Lantern (TETH) - Laetitia (HE) - Portrait of Another World (HE Tool) - The Burrowing Heaven (WAW) - Flesh Idol (WAW Tool)
